slices.focus: Ariana shifts from reactive intake to targeted expansion focused on underdocumented corridors
slices.summary: With 300+ recordings preserved, Ariana realizes the easiest family referrals are exhausted. She moves to a targeted expansion phase prioritizing underdocumented commercial corridors, funeral-home networks, and church anniversaries, using a triage rule of vulnerability, uniqueness, and gap fit.
open_loops: Writing a one-page map of the three priority lanes with triage rules
Choosing one concrete outreach action per lane in the first month
Presenting the strategic shift to her supervisor as collection balance and public value
